units.source_text: 他实在不得要领，在混乱和不安之中，男人终于呆立不动了。

en.t: He could make no sense of it at all, and amid confusion and unease, the man finally stood there motionless.

units.source_text: 本应把敌我双方涂抹得清清楚楚的作战地图，被暧昧的中间色弄淡成一幅猜谜画。

en.t: The battle map, which should have marked friend and foe in clear colors, had been blurred by ambiguous middle tones into a kind of puzzle picture.

units.source_text: 其实仔细一想，它充其量不过是一本漫画，没有必要那样怒不可遏。

en.t: In fact, when he thought it over carefully, it was at most only a comic book, and there was no need to fly into such a rage.

units.source_text: 你是否傻乎乎地笑了，根本就没有关心的人呐……僵硬的舌头深处，断断续续地嘀咕起来。

en.t: Whether you smiled foolishly or not, there was really no one who cared... From deep in his stiff tongue, he began muttering in broken fragments.
